activeAlerts.headline: ✅ Energy Burden Manageable: 6.1% of World GDP (Brent at $74.8/bbl)
activeAlerts.body: Current energy expenditure is comfortably below the 8.0% recession warning threshold, providing a stable tailwind to the global physical economy.

activeAlerts.headline: 📉 Deglobalization / Fragmentation: Trade at 57.2% (-3.8% vs 2008 Peak)
activeAlerts.body: World trade peaked as a share of GDP in 2008 (61.0%). Active geoeconomic fragmentation, tariff escalation, and friendshoring policies have permanently plateaued cross-border merchandise intensity.

activeAlerts.headline: ⏳ Secular Demographic Cliff: Working-Age Contraction in China, Japan & EU
activeAlerts.body: Working-age populations are contracting across China (-0.45% p.a.), Germany (-0.55% p.a.), and Japan (-0.75% p.a.). Rising old-age dependency ratios cement permanent fiscal dominance and age-related entitlement liabilities.
